family.amstrad-pc6000.description: Amstrad’s home-PC transition to the 486SX, represented by the PC6486SX.
family.amstrad-pc6000.history: In June 1992, Tilt presented the PC6486SX as a new consumer model and anticipated a 6000 range replacing the 5000 while retaining its approach. Science & Vie Micro subsequently placed the 6486SX in the mass-market offering alongside the new professional 8486 line. These reports document the intention to renew the range; they do not establish when each earlier model was withdrawn.
